title: Chennai Tour Packages: Best Local Sightseeing, Temple & Outstation Tours
excerpt: Book customized Chennai tour packages with SR Tours & Travels. Explore Marina Beach, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, Tirupati, Kanchipuram, Rameswaram, Ooty & Kodaikanal in comfortable AC vehicles.
description: Affordable Chennai tour packages from SR Tours & Travels. Customized 1-day Chennai sightseeing, Tirupati, Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, Rameswaram, Ooty & Kodaikanal tours. Call +91 9884300373.
html:
Planning a family holiday, pilgrimage, or weekend getaway? SR Tours & Travels offers carefully curated Chennai tour packages tailored for families, couples, senior citizens, and corporate groups — complete with clean AC vehicles, experienced drivers, and flexible itineraries.

Top Chennai Tour Packages

  • 1-Day Chennai City Sightseeing Package: Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Santhome Basilica, Marina Beach, Government Museum, Valluvar Kottam, Guindy National Park, and Vandalur Zoo.
  • Spiritual & Temple Tour Packages from Chennai: Daily Tirupati Darshan, Kanchipuram Temple Tour, Thiruvannamalai, Kumbakonam Navagraha Tour, Arupadai Veedu, and Rameswaram Tour Packages.
  • Coastal & Heritage Weekend Packages: Mahabalipuram UNESCO Heritage Tour and Pondicherry French Quarter & Auroville Tour.
  • Hill Station Tour Packages from Chennai: Ooty, Kodaikanal, Yercaud, Yelagiri, Munnar, Wayanad, and Valparai.

Vehicles Available for Chennai Tour Packages

Choose from AC Sedans (Dzire / Etios), Family SUVs (Innova / Innova Crysta / Hycross), Luxury Tempo Travellers (12–18 Seater), and Mini Buses. Check our Tariff or browse all Tour Packages.

Book Your Chennai Tour Package

Call +91 9884300373 / 9884050506 or request a custom quote for instant confirmation.
